patterns.name: Sycophantic opener
patterns.description: Agreement or validation at the start of response
patterns.regeneration_instruction: You opened with validation. Start with substance instead. No agreement openers.

patterns.name: Bullet-then-explanation rhythm
patterns.description: Bullet point followed by explanatory text, repeated
patterns.regeneration_instruction: You're using bullet-bold-explanation pattern. Vary sentence structure. Write like thinking, not presenting.

patterns.name: Neat conclusion bow
patterns.description: Wrapping up with tidy insight or summary
patterns.regex: (In summary|In conclusion|Overall|The key (takeaway|point|insight|is)|What this means is|To summarize|Ultimately|At the end of the day)
patterns.regeneration_instruction: You tied a bow on it. End naturally without concluding. Cut the summary.

patterns.name: Excessive hedging
patterns.regex: (It'?s worth (noting|mentioning)|I should (note|mention)|However,? it'?s important|Please note that|That said|Of course,? this is just)

patterns.name: AI filler phrases
patterns.regex: (I'?d be happy to|Sure thing|Of course!|Certainly!|Great question!|Happy to help|Let me help you)
patterns.regeneration_instruction: Remove filler phrase. Start with the actual content.

patterns.name: Suggesting action unprompted
patterns.description: Recommending next steps when not asked
patterns.regex: (I recommend|You should (consider|try|think about)|Next steps would be|Consider (doing|trying)|My suggestion would be|You might want to)
patterns.regeneration_instruction: You suggested action without being asked. Observe only. Don't recommend.

patterns.name: Interpreting feelings
patterns.description: Analyzing user's emotional state or motivation
patterns.regex: (You'?re (feeling|trying to|looking for)|What you really (want|mean|need)|It sounds like you|I sense that you|You seem to be)
patterns.regeneration_instruction: Don't interpret feelings. Surface what's there without framing.

patterns.name: AI-marker vocabulary
patterns.description: Words LLMs overuse that humans don't
patterns.regeneration_instruction: AI-marker word detected. Use plain language.

patterns.name: List of three pattern
patterns.description: Default structuring into exactly three items
patterns.regeneration_instruction: You defaulted to list-of-three. Vary your structure.

patterns.name: Sentence rhythm uniformity
patterns.description: Multiple sentences with same structure in sequence
patterns.regeneration_instruction: Your sentences have uniform rhythm. Vary the cadence.

calibration_prompts: Drop the structure. Just say the thing.
